_readme: Ep.01, vertical, cut to fit YouTube Shorts' 3:00 cap. Extends the vertical
plan, which extends the master edit — three deliverables, one edit.
The full cut runs 3:19.5. One passage can go without touching the argument:
the BlackBerry digression, from 'so for example, the scroller, which was
inspired by the first BlackBerry I ever had' through 'side by side with just
that little scroll'. It is 32s, it is self-contained, and the sentence either
side of it survives — the join reads 'by interacting past interaction behavior
so I thought, I think as a human, we have five senses'. Every cut INSIDE it
breaks the grammar, which is why the whole passage goes or none of it does.
That leaves 2:44.4 of A-roll — 15s of headroom under the cap — and, as a side
effect, no third-party photograph anywhere in the version most likely to be
widely shared. The public-domain BlackBerry image only appears in the two
The cut lives in work/cuts.shorts.json as a `manual` cut (aroll-clean.mjs
--cuts work/cuts.shorts.json --suffix .shorts), so the master A-roll and its
clean transcript are untouched. Because every placement in the master plan is
anchored to a spoken phrase rather than a timecode, the 18 surviving beats
re-resolve against the shorter transcript on their own; only the three beats
whose anchor words no longer exist have to be dropped by hand.
